title: CSF metagenomics plus a host-transcriptome classifier for tuberculous meningitis
summary: In 368 prospectively enrolled HIV-infected Ugandan adults with subacute meningitis, CSF metagenomic sequencing identified treatable infectious mimics of TB meningitis. A CSF host-transcriptome machine-learning classifier was trained and evaluated blindly on an independent dataset. The combined assay had 88.9% sensitivity and 86.7% specificity for TB meningitis and its mimics.
ai_technology: Host gene-expression machine-learning classifier on CSF transcriptomes combined with metagenomic sequencing
organization: University of California, San Francisco; University of Melbourne

evidence.tested: Prospective enrolment of 368 adults for sequencing; classifier evaluated blindly on an independent dataset; combined sensitivity 88.9%, specificity 86.7%.
evidence.unknown: Single population (HIV-infected Ugandan adults); classifier test used an independent existing dataset; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning classifier on CSF host transcriptomes supplied the sensitive TB meningitis call that was combined with sequencing.
